data.name: Virginia Gift Manager
data.shortDescription: A mod that allows to customize the Virginia Gift System.
data.description:
This mod allows you to customize the following things about the Virginia Gift System:

- How long it takes between Virginia Gift Visits
- The chance of getting each gift from Virginia.
- The minimum sentiment needed to get that gift from Virginia.

This mod will NOT allow you to choose items outside of her existing pool of items that she gives you. 

Multiplayer note:
This mod is server-side only and is disabled for clients in multiplayer games to prevent game disruption.

Once I figure out multiplayer syncing I will allow the host to determine if they want clients to be able to changethese stats.
